en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand multi‑storey hotel or villa in a spa town setting. The central building has a corner tower with steep roof and decorative cresting; on the tower façade the words "KAISER WILHELM" are visible. It is surrounded by lush trees, a wrought‑iron riverside or park railing in the foreground, and other ornate 19th‑century buildings. In the background, wooded hills rise behind the town, with another large structure on the slope.
